G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: No matching entity on the Texas list of active franchise taxpayers. Texas does not require a sole proprietorship or a general partnership to pay franchise tax, and an exempt entity is left off as well, so this is a check this source cannot complete rather than evidence against the firm. The state's own SOSDirect service can settle it for a fee
G3.source: Active Franchise Taxpayers, published daily as open data by the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, partial
G3.unresolvable: Texas lists only active franchise taxpayers, so a firm that is not obliged to be one cannot be found here however often we look

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 2 named attorneys published.

json_ld_descriptions: Law Offices of Troy A. Brookover is a top-notch personal injury law firm located in San Antonio, Texas serving the local area for 30+ years. Our attorneys are experts in the field of personal injury law and have a deep understanding of the complexities and nuances of each case. We specialize in car, truck, and motorcycle accidents, injury claims, and all other types of personal injury cases. Our goal is to provide top-notch legal services to our clients, and we achieve this by working tirelessly to achieve the best possible outcome for each case. If you've been in an accident and are in need of legal representation, look no further than Law Offices of Troy A. Brookover. Call us today for a free consultation and let us help you get the justice you deserve.
